trips_child_ages_range.name: trips_child_ages_range
trips_child_ages_range.value:
array_position("trips"."child_ages", NULL) IS NULL
        AND 0 <= ALL("trips"."child_ages") AND 17 >= ALL("trips"."child_ages")

itineraries_hotel_total_requires_hotel.name: itineraries_hotel_total_requires_hotel
itineraries_hotel_total_requires_hotel.value: "itineraries"."hotel_total_minor" IS NULL OR "itineraries"."hotel_id" IS NOT NULL

itinerary_items_reference_matches_type.name: itinerary_items_reference_matches_type
itinerary_items_reference_matches_type.value:
CASE "itinerary_items"."type"
        WHEN 'activity' THEN "itinerary_items"."activity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itinerary_items"."hotel_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'hotel' THEN "itinerary_items"."hotel_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itinerary_items"."activity_id" IS NULL
        ELSE "itinerary_items"."activity_id" IS NULL AND "itinerary_items"."hotel_id" IS NULL AND "itinerary_items"."title" IS NOT NULL
      END

itinerary_items_travel_complete.name: itinerary_items_travel_complete
itinerary_items_travel_complete.value:
("itinerary_items"."travel_mode" IS NULL) = ("itinerary_items"."travel_minutes" IS NULL)
        AND ("itinerary_items"."travel_minutes" IS NULL OR "itinerary_items"."travel_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("itinerary_items"."travel_meters" IS NULL OR "itinerary_items"."travel_meters" >= 0)

recommendations_reference_matches_kind.name: recommendations_reference_matches_kind
recommendations_reference_matches_kind.value:
CASE "recommendations"."kind"
        WHEN 'hotel' THEN "recommendations"."hotel_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recommendations"."activity_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'activity' THEN "recommendations"."activity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recommendations"."hotel_id" IS NULL
      END
